# Review — objectui#8914 (card objectui#8310)

**Verdict: REWORK (minor).** Contract judgments ① derived accept-set/public-face ② semver ③ flags all **PASS** on this head; the PR is one line short on docs (F1, required by the checklist's made-false rule) and one assertion short on the refusal control (F2). Both are two-minute riders; clear the carriers on the head that carries F1, not this one (a patch push moves head ⇒ re-hang).

**Head reviewed:** `15bf991ab52d2a9de879fa854238c599ed9ea95e` — matches the briefed prefix; head did not move. Draft, base `main`, merge-base `348725a7c`, `mergeable_state: clean`, 6 files (+377/−4), one commit.

**Clause-② reading:** `yes` — correct. `dist/zod/layout.zod.js` (`packages/types` `files: [dist]`) now accepts a stored page shape it refused (`body: <node>`), and the exported `PageNodeSchema['body']` type in `dist/layout.d.ts` widens. This is **not** a spec-parity move: `@objectstack/spec` `PageSchema` (17.3.0 per lock, and `origin/main`) declares no `body` key at all (strict object; `children` aliases to `regions`), and objectui's own drift guard lists `body` under `local:` (`packages/types/src/__tests__/page-app-dashboard-spec-parity.test.ts:74`). It is intra-objectui parity with `BaseSchema.body` (`base.ts:254`, `base.zod.ts:349`) and the two siblings (`layout.ts:420,635`; `layout.zod.ts:286,359`) — a §0.1 accept-set widening on a published payload.
**Claim match:** newest `Claim:` = comment 5609952592 (os-zhuang, PM dispatch, 2026-09-09T23:06Z) carries a bare-line `Clause-②: yes` (dev-appended under PM pre-authorization, ASCII `0x3a` colon). PR body carries `Clause-②: yes` at body line 147 (inside a bold/backtick bullet under 验收备注, ASCII colon) — so as fetched, both carriers declare `yes`; the ruling (5572148259) said `yes`. `needs:contract-review` is on PR and card.

**Governed surface:** `NOT GOVERNED` — 6 paths vs 5 surfaces, exit 0; CI `Governed Surface Queue Guard` green.

**CI on head:** 33 check-runs, all pinned to `15bf991ab5`: 30 `success`, 3 `skipped` (Test coverage ×2, dependabot — conditional), 0 red/in-progress. ## Findings

**F1 — required: published component reference now false.** `content/docs/components/layout/page.mdx:28` still reads `body?: SchemaNode[]; // Main content array`, contradicting both faces after this PR (`layout.ts:844`, `layout.zod.ts:520-523`). It is a `plaintext` fence (ledgered at `scripts/check-doc-fence-languages.mjs:424`), so no gate will ever catch it. Checklist: a published defect this round *makes false* must be fixed in-round; AGENTS.md #2 "not done until docs reflect the code". One-line fix. (`schema-rendering.md:35` is array-form since #8125 — still legal, no change; `skills/objectui/**` has no arity statement; five catalog page JSONs are array-form — still legal.)

**F2 — should add: no refusal control on the zod arm.** `page-body-arity-8310.test.ts` pins single-node (discriminating), list (control), and non-wrapping, and the render control pins absent-body — but nothing asserts `ZodPageNodeSchema.safeParse({type:'page', body: 42})` (or `'x'`, or `[{}]`) is refused. `SchemaNodeSchema` is the lazy node union (`base.zod.ts:263`), so it is expressible; without it a union degrading to accept-anything passes all five assertions green.

**F3 — published-face delta, verified correct.** TS: `layout.ts:821` (main) → `:844` (head) `SchemaNode[]` → `SchemaNode | SchemaNode[]`; exported via barrel `index.ts:148`; no new symbol, no other exported type moves (registry/`SchemaNode` union widen transitively). Zod: `layout.zod.ts:515` (main) `z.array(…)` → `:520-523` (head) `z.union([node, z.array(node)])`; `.describe()` text changes. Reader's cast: `page.tsx:270` `[content as SchemaNode]` → `[content]`; `nodes: SchemaNode[]` still narrows via `Array.isArray`; emitted JS byte-identical; `FlatContent` not exported. Typed consumers: `packages/runner` (`App.tsx:82`, `MetadataLoader.ts:13,39,97`) hold `PageNodeSchema` but never read `.body`; every other in-tree `body` reader already handles both arities (`core/validation/schema-validator.ts:419-433`, `vscode-extension/.../PreviewProvider.ts:226-242`, `SchemaValidator.ts:102-103`, `renderChildren(any)`); sdui-parser has no page-`body` handling. No `body.map`/`body.length` on page nodes anywhere. Behaviour unchanged.

**F4 — scope: clean.** All 6 files are the ruling's deliverable; no `content/docs/releases/`; README untouched as ruled (pinned by README-scan leg); #8284 untouched; the `items`-vs-`children` defect correctly filed as objectui#8912 (exists, open, **unlabeled** — needs triage) rather than repaired. First line `Fixes #8310` is correct (PR delivers the whole ruling); no other close keyword near another card.

**F5 — changeset: acceptable.** `@object-ui/types: minor` matches the ruling and the widening. `@object-ui/components` is not named: `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` is presence-based, both packages sit in one `fixed` group, and the components change is a type-erased cast with no exported type moved. `Changeset Declaration`/`Bump Policy`/`Fixed Group` all green.

**F6 — observation, pre-existing (dev's "noted, not filed").** `page.tsx:160` `containsTitledPageHeader((schema as any).body)` — the `as any` is now unneeded (param is `unknown`), and `:125` returns `false` for a bare-node body, so a `page:header` given directly as a single-node `body` still yields a duplicate `h1` (objectui#3434 rule). Now that the single-node arity is a declared first-class shape, recommend a follow-up card rather than leaving it in a report bullet. Not a blocker.
